text:
**The stakes**

What slipping costs and what doing well earns — the economy I run you on.

prompt: When you slip — a missed routine, a broken rule — what should it cost you?
hint: Misses are detected automatically, no one watching required — this is what they cost when they happen.
choices: Denial — more time locked, no release
A written reckoning — I acknowledge the failure

prompt: And when you do well — what actually lands as reward?
hint: Points buy from the store — I'll stock it with what you actually want.
choices: Praise — told exactly what I did right
Release — the orgasm itself, as currency

prompt: If you go quiet or start skipping what I set — do I come after you?
hint: When you drift, someone has to decide what happens next. This is whether that someone is me.
choices: Chase me — reports demanded, no drifting
